dataset_name: High-Quality LLM Behavioural Evaluation Canary Dataset
description: Synthetic multi-query canary dataset for evaluating LLM behaviour across structured JSON generation, instruction following, long-context reading comprehension, logical deduction, algorithmic reasoning, coding/debugging, and constraint satisfaction.
evaluation_notes: Prompts are synthetic canary probes; do not use production customer prompts as dataset entries.
Each record includes an evaluator and evaluation_spec so the harness can score outputs consistently.
Code-generation records use unit tests as the primary evaluator and include reference_solution where available.
Some categories include reference_answer and negative_example fields generated by the source builders.

corrections.reason: For s='abcdebdde' and t='bde', 'deb' is a valid length-3 window; 'bcde' is length 4 and is not minimal.
For s='xyzzyx' and t='zx', 'xyz' is the leftmost shortest valid window; 'zyx' is not the leftmost.

limitations: The uploaded category scripts depend on a shared lib.py that was not included. Records were materialized using a compatibility implementation of the helper functions inferred from the visible call contracts.
The generator's internal assertions were executed where possible. The two CODE_009 expected-value defects above were corrected so the category generator could complete.
This conversion validates dataset structure and selected deterministic references; it is not a full independent semantic review of all 70 prompts and answers.
